name: Migrate Sakila Database and Create Application Database for brightstar.test
description:
BrightStar Media (brightstar.test) needs database infrastructure for their new video catalog application. Perform the following in Virtualmin:

1. Create a new MySQL database named 'brightstar_catalog' (Virtualmin may auto-prefix it) under the brightstar.test domain.
2. Grant the brightstar.test domain's MySQL user full access to the 'sakila' database (this database already exists on the server with sample film/actor data — it was imported during server setup).
3. Create a table called 'video_categories' in the brightstar_catalog database with at least these columns: id (INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY), name (VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL), description (TEXT), created_at (TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP).
4. Insert at least 5 rows into the 'video_categories' table using real film genre categories (e.g., Action, Comedy, Drama, Documentary, Horror — these categories are found in the sakila.category table for reference).
